title: San Diego Taiwanese Cultural Association 南加州 聖地亞哥台灣同鄉會
content_html: The San Diego Taiwanese Cultural Association (SDTCA, 聖地牙哥台灣同鄉會) is a regional chapter of the Taiwanese Association of America (TAA, 全美台灣同鄉會), the national umbrella organization serving Taiwanese American communities across the United States. The chapter is based in San Diego, California, and is listed under the TAA Western (美西) region alongside other California and Pacific chapters.
